_ARCHIVED_SNAPSHOT: NOT THE RUNTIME RULE PACK. This is a frozen blueprint copy kept only so the project could be rebuilt from zero; it is not imported, built, tested or served by anything, and it has NOT been kept in step with the live packs. The authoritative pack this file is a stale copy of lives at pathwise-app/lib/rulepacks/consequence-map.json. Read that one. Any verified_on date below describes the snapshot as it stood when it was taken, not a verification of this file.
description: The Event Consequence Engine's core table. One life event -> consequences across all three domains. This is the product's central originality: it is why PathWise is one product, not three.

job_offer_signed.summary: Student signs a job offer with a future start date.

consequences.effect: Unemployment counter does NOT stop. A signed offer with a future start date does not stop the clock; days between now and the start date still count.

cite.text: Days are cumulative; future start dates count.

consequences.effect: New 10-day SEVIS reporting obligation once employment begins.

new_deadline.consequence_of_missing: Failure to report can lead toward the 90-day no-report auto-termination.

consequences.effect: A job can be a domicile intent factor; if it were the last qualifying factor, the one-year clock would start today.

cite.text: The clock starts at the date of the last qualifying intent factor.

consequences.effect: An earlier finding is now stale. "No immediate OPT risk" was computed before this offer and must be recomputed.

cite.text: Findings are re-derived when the timeline changes.

job_started.summary: Student's qualifying employment (>= 20 hrs/week) actually begins.

consequences.effect: Unemployment counter stops as of the actual start date IF the job is >= 20 hrs/week and in-field.

cite.text: A single <20 hr/week job does not stop the counter.

consequences.effect: Report the employment in SEVIS within 10 days of start.
May start or advance the domicile clock as an intent factor (unless co-op, which confers no domicile). If it is the last qualifying factor, the one-year clock starts today.

cite.text: Clock starts at the last qualifying intent factor.

consequences.effect: Any prior OPT-risk or unemployment finding computed before this event is now stale and must be recomputed.
60-day grace period starts the day after degree requirements are met (not necessarily the I-20 end date).

new_deadline.consequence_of_missing: Falls out of status unless a qualifying action occurred first.

level_changed.summary: Student moves to a higher education level (e.g., bachelor's -> master's).

consequences.effect: CPT/OPT cap RESETS for the new level. Prior-level CPT days no longer count toward the new level's 365-day cliff.
DSO must issue a new I-20 for the new program before the grace period ends.

cite.text: New I-20 before grace period ends.

moved_state.summary: Student physically relocates to a new state.

consequences.effect: Domicile analysis switches to the new state's rule pack; a prior determination does not transfer.
Rebuttable dependency presumption no longer applies; student is evaluated on their own factors.
